query: 'SELECT CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.d, 112) AS INT)                 AS fecha_key,
       f.d                                                     AS fecha_completa,
       CAST(YEAR(f.d) AS SMALLINT)                             AS anio,
       CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.d) AS TINYINT)                 AS trimestre,
       'T' + CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.d) AS VARCHAR(1))        AS trimestre_nombre,
       CAST(MONTH(f.d) AS TINYINT)                             AS mes,
       CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d), 'Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio',
              'Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre') AS mes_nombre,
       CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d), 'Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul',
              'Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic')                   AS mes_corto,
       CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.d) AS TINYINT)                AS semana_anio,
       CAST(DAY(f.d) AS TINYINT)                               AS dia_mes,
       CAST(DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.d) % 7 + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
       CHOOSE(DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.d) % 7 + 1,
              'Lunes','Martes','Miercoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sabado','Domingo') AS dia_nombre,
       CAST(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.d) % 7 + 1 >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT TOP (1461)
           DATEADD(DAY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1, CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)) AS d
    FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
) f',
